ai.seo_question: What makes a believer the most distinguished according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) defines spiritual excellence through proactive self-sacrifice, noting that early generosity secures eternal reward while delay benefits others. He further advises selecting companions based on the principle that a follower is judged by their leader, warning against those whose opinions are esteemed but whose actions are flawed.
